issue.body:
## Outcome

Produce one portable Runtime Terraform module family replacing the exact existing CloudFormation-template denominator on AWS and GCP.

## Primary deliverable

One portable workload contract with provider-specific AWS and GCP Terraform implementations for the exact issue 194 and 268 template behaviors.

## Verification result

Input, topology, IAM, tag, deadline, output, failure, rollback, plan, disposable-deployment, and zero-resource parity pass on both provider implementations.

## Unit boundary

Issue completion is exactly one accepted cross-cloud Terraform module family; provider modules and parity deployments are implementation parts and evidence inputs.

## Dependencies

- AWS-E: #488
- GCP-D: #493

## Retained predecessor scope

- None; this is new v0.92.1 work.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The portable workload contract is provider-neutral
- [ ] AWS and GCP modules preserve the exact admitted template behavior
- [ ] Provider identity and differences remain explicit
- [ ] Neither provider silently substitutes for the other
- [ ] Existing CloudFormation remains rollback authority until AWS-G

## Owned paths

- `infra/runtime-portable/**`
- `infra/aws/runtime/**`
- `infra/gcp/workloads/**`
- `docs/milestones/v0.92.1/evidence/cloud/xcl-01/**`

## PVF lanes

- `template-denominator`
- `portable-contract`
- `aws-plan-and-deploy`
- `gcp-plan-and-deploy`
- `cross-provider-parity`
- `rollback`
- `cleanup-zero`

## Stop conditions

- A template behavior is unmapped
- Provider-specific security is hidden behind a false abstraction
- Either cleanup proof fails
- Paid authorization is absent

## Non-goals

- One Terraform resource graph spanning both providers
- CloudFormation deletion
- Production cutover
